_README: Template for the manual verified-data importer.
Every value marked REPLACE_ME must be filled in by a person who has
checked the fact against the source document. The importer refuses any
file that still contains a placeholder, so this template cannot be
sourceType must be MANUALLY_VERIFIED or PARTNER_API. Synthetic data is
refused: demo products belong in the demo catalogue.
A change to a product's terms is a NEW versionLabel, never an edit to an
existing one. Re-importing the same label only refreshes its provenance.

versions.productName: REPLACE_ME — the product name as it appears in the wording
versions.uinOrReference: REPLACE_ME — UIN or the insurer's own reference
versions.sourceName: REPLACE_ME — the document you read, e.g. 'Policy wording v3.pdf'
versions.sourceReference: REPLACE_ME — where in it, e.g. 'Section 4.2, page 11'
versions.verifiedBy: REPLACE_ME — the person who checked it
